## Priority
**Nice-to-Have #12** - Lower priority, implement if targeting larger customers

## Description
Add enterprise features like SSO, audit logs, and team management capabilities to attract and serve larger customers.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] SSO integration (SAML, OAuth)
- [ ] Comprehensive audit logging
- [ ] Team/organization management
- [ ] Role-based permissions (admin, member, viewer)
- [ ] Usage analytics per organization
- [ ] SLA commitments documented

## Enterprise Features to Consider

### Single Sign-On (SSO)
- SAML 2.0 support
- OAuth/OIDC integration
- Support popular providers (Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace)

### Audit Logging
- Log all user actions
- Exportable audit logs
- Retention per compliance requirements
- Search and filter capabilities

### Team Management
- Organization/workspace concept
- Invite team members
- Role-based access control
- Usage limits per organization

### Enhanced Security
- IP allowlisting
- Session management
- 2FA enforcement for organization
- Data residency options

### Support & SLA
- Dedicated support channel
- SLA guarantees (99.9%+)
- Priority bug fixes
- Custom feature requests

## Implementation Approach
- Phase 1: Team/organization management
- Phase 2: SSO integration
- Phase 3: Audit logging
- Phase 4: Advanced permissions
